description: A plain post about exactly ONE of the user's products, built on that product's own main photo (no new picture is drawn). For two or more products in one post, a product together with a person, or a new picture of the product, use generate_posts with productIds (and characters). Runs asynchronously — the user is notified when posts are ready.

count.description: Number of posts to generate (default 1; only more when the user asks for more)

topic.description: Optional angle or occasion for the posts (e.g. 'summer sale')

name: generate_from_product
title: Generate Posts From Product
